name: sign-in
title: Sign in
description: The sign-in screen of the mangacn auth flow, made only with the kit. A manga Panel: the reader drawn whole in SVG (ink lines, paper fills, a screentone jacket, an open volume), focus SpeedLines around her, a SpeechBubble ('Welcome back! Your shelf missed you.', a shout bubble 'Huh?!' on error, 'Yes!' on success), a Manpu mark and the Sfx ドキッ. From 48rem of container width the panel stands full height on the start side of the form; narrower, it sits above the form in 4:3 with the character whole. The form, in a case (G1) when there is room: email Field, password with a show/hide toggle inside an InputGroup (aria-pressed, touch-hit), a 'Keep me signed in' Checkbox, a Sign in Button with its loading state (fields stay enabled), a 'Forgot password?' link, SocialButtons (Google, Apple by default, no logo shipped) behind an AuthDivider 'or', and 'New here? Create an account'. Errors: field errors (Field) with focus on the first wrong field; wrong credentials (demo: the password 'wrongpass') show a jagged accent box with a '!' mark that shakes, role=alert (G8). Success: an accent Stamp and an 'Enter your code' button for the second step. Links call onNavigate and never navigate. One column on phones with 44px touch targets; container queries widen it. Works in light, dark, any accent and with Radix or Base UI.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/blocks/sign-in". The root fills its container width; the panel and the form sit side by side once the block is 48rem wide. Wire onNavigate to your router (the links and the next-step button call it), pass your own provider marks through providers, and replace the simulated timeouts in submit and social with your own auth calls.

meta.tagline: A manga panel beside the sign-in form, with social buttons and a jagged error box.
